title: Jamaican Fish Bake
description: A flavorful and moist fish dish with Jamaican spices, roasted in the oven, inspired by Thai cuisine.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish with Jamaican jerk seasoning.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, lime juice, and olive oil.
Add the roasted red peppers, garlic, and Thai basil to the bowl and stir to combine.
Place the fish on the prepared baking sheet and brush the coconut milk mixture evenly over the fish.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
